mysql.assessment: The newest checked official MySQL 9.7 image still bundles affected mysqlsh Python packages and a gosu binary built with an older Go standard library. Package-level fixes exist, but this official image has not incorporated them. Scanner findings do not prove exploitability in the ERNIE deployment; no claim of non-exploitability is made.
mysql.action: Keep the required MySQL 9.7 server and its data volume. Review these open findings before release, monitor the official image rebuild, and rescan its new digest. Rebuilding or removing bundled upstream components requires separate image ownership and runtime validation.
mysql.releaseImpact: The existing application-image gate excludes MySQL. These unresolved findings remain a separate release decision; a green application gate does not clear the database image.
